life Complete app · v13
v13 · Teach me, and every next-level feature

Every feature. One calm app that grows with you.

This is the whole of life, with every piece of your feedback in: solid surfaces (no glass), the dot-field Pulse driving a diverse cast of photos, the Chief Aim, a full Body chapter (devices, readiness, sleep, load, photo food logging, habits) and Teach it back. In total, 34 screens in eight chapters, from first open to level four. Every function already in the engine has a home here, the numbers come from the engine itself, and it all speaks one language.
